name: Senior Manager Dashboard and SM&CR Accountability Review

phases.name: Conduct Monitoring and Surveillance Review
phases.description: The quarterly SM&CR review is triggered by the compliance calendar. The Compliance system (SVC-015) generates a conduct monitoring report: communications surveillance scan results (Behavox/NICE), training completion rates, and any open conduct investigations. The Head of Compliance (SMF16) reviews the report via the SM&CR dashboard.
exit_conditions: No unresolved conduct alerts requiring escalation
SmscrReview record created with status = in_progress

phases.name: Accountability Map and SoR Review
phases.description: The compliance team reviews the SM&CR accountability map for role changes since the last review. New Senior Managers or Certified Function individuals are identified. Statements of Responsibilities (SoR) are reviewed for material changes. FCA register updated for any new or changed SMF holders.
exit_conditions: Accountability map updated for role changes
FCA register submissions initiated for any changes
No material SoR changes requiring new approval

phases.name: Board Reporting and Review Closure
phases.description: The Head of Compliance prepares the SM&CR section of the Board Compliance Report. No conduct breaches or notifications required this quarter. SmscrReview updated to status = closed. EVT-165 SmscrReviewCompleted published.

happy_path.description: Quarterly review triggered → no conduct alerts → accountability map reviewed → no material SoR changes → Board report updated → review closed.

alternative_paths.name: Conduct Breach — FCA Notification Required
alternative_paths.description: Conduct monitoring identifies a breach of an FCA Conduct Rule by an SMF holder. FCA breach notification prepared and submitted. SmscrReview status = breach_notified.
alternative_paths.diverges_at: PH-131: Surveillance scan identifies a conduct alert

design_decisions.decision: This journey is single-capability (CAP-005 only). SmscrReview is a compliance governance record owned by SVC-015. No cross-capability events are needed — the review process is entirely internal to CAP-005.
design_decisions.rationale: SM&CR review is a governance process with no domain data dependencies outside CAP-005.
